items.text: Pittsburgh QB: Steelers released Aaron Rodgers (Nov 25); Mason Rudolph starts vs DEN (schedule listing correct).

Pittsburgh (final report): OUT - OLB Alex Highsmith (ankle), WR Ben Skowronek (calf, to IR), G Gennings Dunker (knee, IR). QUESTIONABLE - LB Cole Holcomb (heel). OLB Nick Herbig full Thu, will play; WR Michael Pittman Jr. activated from IR. IR - LG Mason McCormick.

Denver (final report): OUT - DE Sai'vion Jones (hamstring), S Taylor Rapp (quad), TE Caleb Lohner (foot). QUESTIONABLE - RB Tyler Badie (thumb, needs IR activation). S Brandon Jones (hamstring) no designation, set to return. IR - RB RJ Harvey, LB Jonah Elliss. Bo Nix starts.
